meta.title: Bitrox ServiceTracker — Open Source IT Service Desk & Operations Portal
meta.description: Self-hosted, open-source IT service desk unifying hardware repair tickets, printer page counters, BitLocker recovery keys, and maintenance protocols with Snipe-IT integration.
meta.keywords: IT service desk, technical repair tracking software, open source helpdesk, toner counter tracking, Snipe-IT integration

hero.title: Open-Source IT Service Desk for Enterprise Teams
hero.description: Unify hardware failure tickets, printer page counters, BitLocker recovery key vaults, and maintenance handover protocols in a single platform integrated with Snipe-IT.

problemSolution.title: Unify Fragmented IT Operations in One Place
problemSolution.description: While Snipe-IT excels at asset custody counting, field repair stages, toner page counter logs, and signed maintenance forms frequently end up scattered across spreadsheets and paper.

traditional.title: Traditional Fragmented Setup
items: Failure reports arrive via phone, email, or post-it notes; technician intervention and replacement part histories get lost.
Printer toner cartridges are distributed without recording page counters; true cost-per-page yield cannot be tracked.
Branch couriers and depot shipments lack tracking links; labels are manually typed in carrier portals.
Device loan and inspection records are filed in paper folders; retrieving asset audit histories during offboarding takes hours.

modern.title: ServiceTracker Workflow
items: Selecting an employee automatically lists their assigned devices with a structured 5-stage repair and cost ledger.
Each cartridge replacement logs printer page volume; automated threshold warnings trigger before stock runs out.
Inbound and outbound parcels are linked to service tickets; generating standard 100x150 mm thermal shipping barcodes.
Every event converts into printable, signed PDF handover protocols archived directly in your local MySQL database.

workflows.title: 4 Core Flows Built for IT Technicians
workflows.description: Practical workflows eliminating duplicate entries and focused on quick resolution.

items.title: 1. Service Ticket & Repair Lifecycle
items.description: Scan a barcode or enter a serial number for immediate check-in. Deduct replacement parts (SSD, RAM) from local inventory and track total repair expenses.
steps: Serial intake: Serial number, problem description, and employee selection
Staged workflow: New, In Repair, Awaiting Parts, External Service, Completed
Expense tracking: Replaced components and labor cost calculation

items.title: 2. Printer Page Counters & Toner Stock
items.description: Record the page counter on each toner replacement to analyze page yields per cartridge and identify cost patterns across departments.
steps: Page counter recording on cartridge change

items.title: 3. Master Operations Calendar
items.description: Track all service tickets, preventive hardware inspections, courier deliveries, and toner replacements on a unified calendar view.
steps: Unified agenda combining tickets, maintenance, logistics, and supplies
Click any event badge to open the full ticket modal
Color-coded visual alerts for overdue and scheduled services

items.title: 4. Signed PDF Forms & Thermal Barcodes
items.description: Standardized document generation for hardware handovers and courier logistics without requiring third-party software.
steps: Printable hardware handover receipt with technician and recipient signature lines
Zebra and Xprinter compatible 100x150 mm thermal shipping parcel labels

snipeitArchitecture.title: Secure & Read-Only API Synchronization with Snipe-IT
snipeitArchitecture.description: ServiceTracker never writes directly to your Snipe-IT database. It queries the official REST API via Bearer Token and stores read-only snapshots in local MySQL cache tables.

points.title: Read-Only Connection
points.desc: Snipe-IT asset tables are strictly queried; your authoritative ITAM database remains untouched.

points.title: Local MySQL Caching
points.desc: Assets and users are cached locally, ensuring instant lookups during ticket check-in without external lag.

points.title: Complete Standalone Capability
points.desc: If Snipe-IT is unreachable or not used, all ticket, toner, and maintenance modules operate independently.

comparison.title: How Snipe-IT and ServiceTracker Work Together
comparison.description: ServiceTracker is designed to complement Snipe-IT by providing the hands-on workshop workflows, page counter tracking, and signed protocols that fall outside Snipe-IT's ITAM scope.

install.title: Deploy on Your Own Server in Minutes

securityAlert.title: Security Notice (Mandatory Password Change)
securityAlert.desc: Default credentials: Username: admin / Password: admin123. Change your password in Settings or Profile immediately upon first login.

tabs.name: Linux (Ubuntu/Debian)
tabs.code:
git clone https://github.com/KingLyzer/bitrox-service-tracking.git
cd bitrox-service-tracking
npm install
mysql -u root -p < database_schema.sql
cp .env.example .env
# Configure database password in .env
npm run build
npm start

tabs.name: PM2 Service (Production)
tabs.code:
npm install -g pm2
cd /path/to/bitrox-service-tracking
pm2 start server/server.js --name "servicetracker"
pm2 save
pm2 startup

tabs.name: Windows (PowerShell)
tabs.code:
git clone https://github.com/KingLyzer/bitrox-service-tracking.git
cd bitrox-service-tracking
npm install
Get-Content database_schema.sql | mysql -u root -p
Copy-Item .env.example .env
# Configure database password in .env
npm run build
npm start

security.title: Your Data Stays on Your Infrastructure
security.description: No external cloud dependencies. Your database resides entirely on your own server.

items.title: On-Premise Architecture
items.desc: Functions fully on your local network (LAN) even without internet connectivity.

items.title: Bcrypt Hashing
items.desc: Passwords are protected using industry-standard one-way bcrypt hashing.

items.title: Granular Permission Matrix
items.desc: Restricts technicians to specific modules with granular view/edit/delete flags.

items.title: Immutable Audit Trails
items.desc: Critical operations such as ticket deletion or status edits are logged with timestamps.

items.q: Can I use Bitrox ServiceTracker without Snipe-IT?
items.a: Yes. Snipe-IT integration is completely optional. All repair tickets, printer counters, inventory, tasks, and maintenance modules operate standalone on your local database.

items.q: Are there per-user licensing fees or subscriptions?
items.a: No. The software is released under the permissive MIT license. It is 100% free with no user or device limitations.

items.q: Where is data stored? Does it send telemetry to third parties?
items.a: All data is stored exclusively in your own on-premise MySQL database. No telemetry, customer data, or keys are sent to external cloud servers.

items.q: Does Snipe-IT integration write directly to my database?
items.a: No. Integration is performed via Snipe-IT's official REST API v1 using Bearer Token authorization with read-only requests.

items.q: Can ServiceTracker run as a native desktop application?
items.a: Yes. Built-in Electron packaging allows compiling native desktop binaries for Windows (exe/zip) and Linux (AppImage/deb).
Node.js 18+, MySQL or MariaDB 8.0+, Git, and npm or yarn package manager.

items.q: How are BitLocker recovery keys secured?
items.a: BitLocker keys are stored in your local database and protected by granular role-based permissions to prevent unauthorized viewing.

items.q: How does the toner page counter work?
items.a: Technicians record the printer page counter upon each cartridge swap. The system computes the page delta since the last swap to calculate true cartridge yield.
